results.name: rusted robot
results.description:
### Rusted Robot

The **Rusted Robot** is an old, battered machine that has survived years of neglect, battles, and harsh environments. Its faded green metal body is covered in **rust, scratches, dents, and peeling paint**, giving it a worn but charming appearance.

Despite its small size and clumsy-looking design, the Rusted Robot is surprisingly durable. Its mechanical arms end in sharp gripping claws, while its heavy metal feet allow it to keep moving even through rough terrain. A tiny spring antenna on its head twitches whenever its sensors detect danger.

Its original programming is partially corrupted, causing it to behave unpredictably. Sometimes it acts like a harmless little companion; other times, its ancient combat protocols suddenly acts.

results.name: Valkyrie Mech (female)
results.description:
### Valkyrie Mech

The **Valkyrie Mech** is an elite female combat machine designed for high-speed assaults and aerial warfare. Built with a sleek armored frame and advanced mechanical wings, she combines the precision of a fighter jet with the strength of a frontline warrior.

Her reinforced armor protects critical systems while keeping her lightweight and agile. Her mechanical wings allow her to launch into the air, dodge enemy attacks, and perform devastating dive strikes. Equipped with an energy spear and integrated weapons, the Valkyrie Mech can switch effortlessly between close-range combat and ranged attacks.

Despite her machine nature, the Valkyrie possesses an advanced tactical AI that gives her a strong sense of duty and an instinct to protect her allies. On the battlefield, she is calm and calculated—but when her squad is threatened, she becomes an unstoppable force.

results.name: LBX 3D Model ODIN
results.description:
Lbx Odin is one of the iconic and famous robots along with Achilles for fans of Danball Senki Odin needs no introduction for everyone else background information. 
Odin (オーディーン, Ōdīn) is Ban Yamano's second LBX introduced in the Danball Senki series.
Origin
Odin was Ban Yamano's second LBX after his old LBX, Achilles, was destroyed in combat. Within the Platinum Capsule, there were blueprints drawn by Junichirou Yamano to create Ban's unique LBX. With the core skeleton, VX-13, Tiny Orbit began producing a LBX that would exceed the common practice of LBX development. Their goal was to create a special LBX that would have a flight mode with the help of an Airframe design. This LBX was finally completed in episode 27.
Description
Jet Form
Odin has a simplified body construction to maximize the two-way switch between a LBX and its Jet Form, flight gear, like wings, shoulder armor, that functions as exhausts in its Jet Form, a gladiator's helmet, reminiscent of Achilles' and a royal blue-purple color scheme.
